name: Barbell Decline Bench Press
steps: Set a moderate decline, secure your legs and take an overhand grip just outside shoulder width.
Set your shoulders against the pad, brace your abdomen and unrack the bar over your shoulders.
Lower the bar smoothly to your lower chest while keeping your elbows angled roughly 45 degrees from your torso.
Press the bar upward until your arms straighten and it is balanced over your shoulders.
tips: Keep your shoulder blades pinned back against the pad throughout each repetition.
Control the touch on your lower chest without bouncing the bar upward.
